name: Joyride
source:
You're going to be kicked off the spaceship if you don't find a cow. Problem is, you have to talk to all of your ex-partners in order to get that cow. God, your life is a soap opera.

[From [url=https://peterwonica.itch.io/joyride]itch.io[/url]]
